answer: Each round the same emission pool is divided across seats drawn by an epoch seed, so one seat earns pool-over-seats and a thousand clones earn a thousandth each. Fakes cannot enlarge the pool; they only send a ripple through the divisor. Each clone still needs its own proof inside the window, its own distinct answer and its own quorum, compute and waiting repeated per identity. The attacker must forge a thousand attestations to collect what one honest seat already got, while one failed quorum drags the cluster grade down. A sparrow feeding alone gets the same grain as a flock of a thousand.
